newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on Friday after weekly receipts of 34,400 head, compared to Thursdays close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales
